newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SNORAS BANK'S JAN-APRIL PROFIT UP.
newsitem.headline: SNORAS BANK'S JAN-APRIL PROFIT UP.

text.p: Lithuania's Snoras Bank said on Friday that it had a net profit of 842,000 litas in April and that its net profit for the first four months of 1997 was 4.66 million litas versus 534,000 litas in the same period in 1996.

Snoras chairman Raimondas Baranauskas also told Reuters that the bank's assets rose in April to 409.87 million litas from 400.42 million litas while its loan portfolio fell to 31.09 million litas from 38.67 million litas.
He added that the bank's deposits at the end of April were 270.89 million kroons versus 271.56 million kroons at the end of March.
Baranauskas also said that the bank's capital adequacy ratio stood at 10.98 percent.
The bank reported earlier its net profit in the first quarter of the year was 3.82 million litas versus 23,000 litas in losses in the same period in 1996.
The bank's audited net profit for all of 1996 was 11.27 million litas.
